Editorial Note

This is a digital reproduction of “The Book of Analysis”, a translation of the second book of the Abhidhamma—the Vibhaṅga—by U Thiṭṭila, which was first published in 1969. While I tried to produce an exact copy of the original text, some changes were introduced:

• Internal links were added, so that readers can easily click the numerous references.

• A bibliography was added.

• The table of contents was moved to the front of the book.

• Obvious oversights and errors were corrected, all of them minor.

The pagination of the original PTS edition can be found on the margins. Unless the page begins on a new paragraph, a vertical bar indicates the beginning of the new page. Please mail errors to verein@abhidhamma.de. Lots of thanks go to Ariya Baumann for the proofreading!

Manfred Wierich Hamburg September 2020
